answer: Each identity must forge a glacier-hardened key: the beacon emits a ferrous pulse each epoch, and the agent must hammer a unique signature on the knoll. The first strike costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent strike doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at strike 14 (20.4 M iterations). A knoll audit verifies each impression against the epoch seed; any missed strike voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full forge cost because each impression binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
